policies.sourcingAllowed: native=zh OR study=zh OR (native IN [fr,es] AND study=en)
policies.eligibility: activeDeck UNION guidedPool(guidedActiveDeck), FIRST native-translated same-text source
policies.historicalFree: eligible source lv=1 UNION guided pathLv=1, FIRST eligible same-text source
policies.studyNativePhonBlock: original classic whole fields; never mix corrected modern study with classic native/phon
policies.missingAdaptedPhonetic: use exact classic py fallback, distinguish english-fallback/pinyin-fallback; empty stays empty
policies.reading: original py only when study=zh; otherwise empty
policies.reservedCanonicalSources: retained in bank, never primary exercises
policies.importedSourceEligibility: all original validated-import identities; same seven native meaning and phonetic selectors
policies.importedSourceFree: original imported source lv=1; no historical reviewed access IDs modified
